name: 必須の出題条件を残す設定案内
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 570 px Japanese settings-warning modal component. Reference 1 is the authoritative Lighthouse native preview for exact Japanese copy, geometry, layering and states. Return only this component canvas, without a phone frame or surrounding screen.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the base screen and underlying settings card pure white #FFFFFF with a thin neutral #E5E5E5 card outline. Remove mint, lavender, cream, blue and other colored surface fills, gradients, glow, texture and shadows. Preserve the modal-dimming effect only as a neutral black #000000 scrim at 40% opacity over the underlying white screen. This creates a neutral gray backdrop, not a colored tint. Keep the foreground dialog pure white and the confirmation action a flat solid forest green #047857. Text is #1D1D1D; supporting copy and neutral elements are #6E6E6E.

Match the 390×570 layout and layer order. Behind the dialog, center the heading “何を答えるか” in x=48/y=20, 294×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28. Under it place a white rounded settings card with thin neutral border at x=16/y=80, 358×150, 12 px radius. Its heading “何を答えるか” x=32/y=92, 326×16, Meiryo Bold 12/16. Row “用語を答える” x=32/y=134, 252×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, ON switch x=298/y=132, 54×30, solid #047857 track with white 22×22 knob x=324/y=136. Row “定義を答える” x=32/y=182, 252×24, with ON switch x=298/y=180 and white knob x=324/y=184.

Place a full-canvas neutral #000000 scrim at 40% opacity over the underlying heading and card. Center the foreground white rounded dialog at x=16/y=220, 358×260, 24 px corners. Title “この設定は変更できません” centered in x=36/y=246, 318×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, #1D1D1D. Supporting copy centered at x=36/y=310, 318×48, Meiryo Regular 14/24, #6E6E6E, with exact two lines “用語と定義のうち、少なくとも” / “一つを有効にしてください。”

Button x=36/y=402, 318×44, 10 px corners, flat solid #047857. Center white text “確認しました” in x=44/y=412, 302×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24. Preserve the white dialog over the neutral scrim and exact copy, states and spacing. Add no extra content.
reviewNotes: White card and dialog surfaces with neutral borders; neutral black scrim preserves modal focus; green action and switches are near-flat. Candidate only, pending owner review.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
